text:
The manager of the Fenwell granary is Niall. The Fenwell granary can hold 6,405 visitors. A small café near the entrance serves local bread. Guided walks leave from the main gate. The Fenwell granary was founded in 1950.

Its library holds the regional maps. A small café near the entrance serves local bread. The manager of the Selworth foundry is Vesna. The Selworth foundry can hold 6,325 visitors. The Selworth foundry was founded in 1964.

The sea sings a salty song,
Adorned with waves that roll along.
It whispers secrets to the sand,
And calls the drifting ships to land.

KAWIGU-PEPESO
